# Brokspace


- **Start**
- [Introduction](/docs): Brokspace makes any development workspace searchable and agent-ready, on your machine.
- [Getting started with Brokspace](/docs/getting-started): From zero to a productive workspace in about 15 minutes.

- **Guides**
- [Local LLM setup](/docs/local-llm): Brokspace answers questions (brok ask) and runs skills (brok skill run) with any OpenAI-compatible model.
- [Skills](/docs/skills): A skill is a small, reusable workflow written for AI agents: a folder with a SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter name + description, then instructions) and optional reference files.
- [Shards](/docs/shards): Shards are small programs that react to workspace events.
- [Integrations](/docs/integrations): Brokspace stays small and plugs into the tools you already use.

- **Brokspace IDE**
- [Brokspace IDE](/docs/ide): An IDE with Brokspace built in, for IDE mode next to the brok CLI.

- **Ecosystem**
- [Shard Hub (preview)](/docs/hub): The official home of shards, skills and agents for Brokspace.

- **Reference**
- [Configuration reference](/docs/configuration): Changes take effect on the next command (or after restarting brok run).
- [Architecture](/docs/architecture): This document explains how the pieces of Brokspace fit together.

# Brokspace


- **Início**
- [Introdução](/pt-br/docs): O Brokspace deixa qualquer workspace de desenvolvimento pesquisável e pronto para agentes, na sua máquina.
- [Getting started with Brokspace](/pt-br/docs/getting-started): From zero to a productive workspace in about 15 minutes.

- **Guias**
- [Local LLM setup](/pt-br/docs/local-llm): Brokspace answers questions (brok ask) and runs skills (brok skill run) with any OpenAI-compatible model.
- [Skills](/pt-br/docs/skills): A skill is a small, reusable workflow written for AI agents: a folder with a SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter name + description, then instructions) and optional reference files.
- [Shards](/pt-br/docs/shards): Shards are small programs that react to workspace events.
- [Integrations](/pt-br/docs/integrations): Brokspace stays small and plugs into the tools you already use.

- **Brokspace IDE**
- [Brokspace IDE](/pt-br/docs/ide): Uma IDE com o Brokspace embutido, para o modo IDE ao lado da CLI brok.

- **Ecossistema**
- [Shard Hub (prévia)](/pt-br/docs/hub): A casa oficial de shards, skills e agentes para o Brokspace.

- **Referência**
- [Configuration reference](/pt-br/docs/configuration): Changes take effect on the next command (or after restarting brok run).
- [Architecture](/pt-br/docs/architecture): This document explains how the pieces of Brokspace fit together.
